## About
Frank Perr started Perr Truck Body in a small shop on Elston Ave. in Chicago. When he outgrew it, he bought land opened up by the new tollway out here in Des Plaines. At the time, it was the super boonies.
Tony and Bill Slivka grew up in the truck business. Their father Ray was a well known International truck franchisee, and both of them worked in the family business from a very young age. When Frank, a long time family friend, decided to retire and go fishing, Tony and Bill took over the reins.
We love trucks. We collect them, we restore them for fun, and they're how we get around. Whether you have one truck or a fleet, we'd like to make your life a little easier. We're proud members of the Des Plaines Chamber of Commerce.

## Services
- Collision repair on medium and heavy duty trucks: Complete collision repair for medium and heavy duty trucks, one truck or a whole fleet.
- Frame and Axle correction Services: Complete frame and axle correction, now offered at the shop.
- Aluminum dry freight box repair: We repair aluminum dry freight boxes.
- Body work and restoration: Body work and restoration for trucks, done in a spray booth that can handle the big ones.
- WELDING-ALUMINUM AND STEEL: Straight from our service menu.
- METAL FABRICATION-BENDING AND SHEERING: Straight from our service menu.
- Fiberglass repair and restoration: Repair and restoration of fiberglass truck parts.
- Computer estimating with digital photographs & e-mail: Send us photos of the damage by email and we'll work up an estimate.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: Yes. Estimating takes real time, so there is a $115.00 charge for estimates. It's refunded if we do the work.

Q: Do you repair trailers?
A: No. We have not offered trailer repair for the last 15 years. We work on trucks and truck boxes.

Q: Can I send photos of the damage?
A: Yes. We do computer estimating with digital photographs and email. One reviewer emailed photos and the make and model of the box and got a quote almost immediately.

Q: Do you work with fleets?
A: We do. If you have one truck or a fleet of trucks, we'd like to make your life a little easier.
